title: Testing
description: Writing tests in Go with the testing package

exercises.title: Basic Test
exercises.description: Split your buffer with `---`: above, `Sum` and `main`; below, `TestSum` in `main_test.go` that expects `Sum(2,3)==5`. Press **`r`** runs `go test`.

exercises.title: Table-Driven Test
exercises.description: Write a table-driven test for a Multiply function. Test with pairs: (2,3)->6, (0,5)->0, (-1,4)->-4.

exercises.title: Subtests
exercises.description: Write tests for a Divide function using subtests. Test success case (10, 2)->5 and error case (10, 0)->error.
hints: Check result and err in each

exercises.title: Benchmark Test
exercises.description: Write a benchmark for the Sum function. Create BenchmarkSum that calls Sum(b.N) iterations to measure performance.
hints: Use for i := 0; i < b.N; i++ { Sum(2, 3) }

exercises.title: Error Test
exercises.description: Write a test that verifies the error message for invalid input in a Validate function.
hints: Use errors.Is or strings.Contains to check error message
